prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1221; do not mention it.)
text: This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits available under the policy at issue, along with the names of any additional coverages that may apply. Your insured and your company are also requested to preserve all evidence relating to the accident, including vehicle data, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, repair records, dashcam or telematics footage, and any communications concerning the loss. Destruction or alteration of such material could prejudice our client's claim. We look forward to your prompt written response.
